record.question: A wise man puts rancour behind and moves ahead
record.explanation: Answer B: hatred. Rancour is enduring hostility or resentment. Among the choices, “hatred” is the closest synonym; mistakes, division and criticism do not name that feeling. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/rancour. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
